experiments.scope: The claimed program (the VOL40 v7e generator, then every pair shifted to schedule words -11..4, all bit-sliced and counted) (proof Sections 2-3) per organizer trial: 256 lanes of pairs from the standard IV with the hard op cap; per kept lane the shifted candidate pair and its J37 landing count; on the first kept lane of the batch the full 51-word schedule control, the sliced-vs-word control, the forced-target tail to step 51 and the bit-30 negative control; per-bit tally on the first kept lane.
experiments.hypothesis: The control lane passes both controls; landing at k bits occurs at rate 2^-k (premise P1); every pair at the target collides after step 51 (premise P2) and the negative control never does; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.

experiments.scope: Evidence mode of the same program (not the charged algorithm; same generator and search as v51-shift-01, 16 control lanes and 32 tally lanes): The claimed program (the VOL40 v7e generator, then every pair shifted to schedule words -11..4, all bit-sliced and counted) (proof Sections 2-3) per organizer trial: 256 lanes of pairs from the standard IV with the hard op cap; per kept lane the shifted candidate pair and its J37 landing count; on the first 16 kept lanes of the batch the full 51-word schedule control, the sliced-vs-word control, the forced-target tail to step 51 and the bit-30 negative control; per-bit tallies on the first 32 kept lanes.
experiments.hypothesis: All kept lanes pass both controls; landing at k bits occurs at rate 2^-k (premise P1); every pair at the target collides after step 51 (premise P2) and the negative control never does; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.
